Theorem
[Li--Yau--Perelman estimate for the heat kernel] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0335 ↗ def:chow-ii-ch16-heat-log-density ↗ thm:chow-ii-ch16-cheeger-yau 1. ch16:16.4\group Heat Harnack

Let $H=(4\pi au )^{-n/2}e^{-f}$ be the positive fundamental solution on a closed manifold with $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$. Then \[ au (2\Delta f-| abla f|^2)+f-n\le 0. \] Equivalently, $2 au \partial _ au f+ au | abla f|^2+f\le 0$.
Proof

\sketch For $W= au (2\Delta f-| abla f|^2)+f-n$, the Bochner formula gives

\[ (\partial _ au -\Delta )W=-2\langle abla f, abla W angle -2 au \left(\left| abla ^2f- rac{g}{2 au } ight|^2 +\operatorname {Rc}( abla f, abla f) ight). \]

The maximum principle and the short-time heat-kernel asymptotics imply $W\le 0$.
